scope: One client bundle experiment in components/club-workspace.tsx: dynamically import five inactive feature components with existing WorkspaceLoading fallback and default SSR; preserve all render guards, props, keys, data fetching, draft/state ownership and live authority.
hypothesis: Avoid loading nonselected settings, meetings and review/decision editor code before Recruiting. Measure destination first-use costs as well as initial source savings; no eager module prefetch to hide the cost.
constraints: No auth success cache, new caching library, GET/resource/transport/policy change, production infrastructure/schema/index/dependency changes or publication. Phase10 font deferral retained.
profiles: 80ms latency, 200000 B/s down, 93750 B/s up, CPU4x

deferredFeatureCost.readiness: Settings actual public-profile form, fixture meeting data, empty scheduled list after fetch, and anonymous-review controls. Anonymous review uses its existing Settings/Application link; warm return uses browser history. Decisions group/details summary open before timed action.

pilot: One baseline/candidate constrained feature protocol sanity probe (8 outcomes each, 16 total), excluded whole. No replacement of individual slow accepted rows.
newRegressionCoverage: Feature-specific built chunks absent before selection; direct links and selected first-use load correctly; a delayed chunk cannot reopen an abandoned tab or survive logout as protected UI; settings draft continuity. Existing transport/dedup/scheduler/rapid-switch/Auth/native suites.
primaryMetric: Full preceding source document useful-content time plus captured requests/script/body bytes and separate subsequent click timing. No readiness clock change. Bounded drains, incomplete background transport flags, fonts/FCP/CLS retained.
power: Temporary caffeinate -dimsu; complete actual power audit; exclude interrupted set whole.
publication: Local commit only; report negative outcomes and global/freshness/server-tail risks.
